title: Evelyn DevX quickfire hackpad — SDK examples & tutorial fixes
content:
Today (quick scratchpad) — goals: finish 30m items, triage sample app bugs, make one tutorial minimal and reproducible.

Top-of-mind TODOs (timebox each: 30–90m):
- [ ] Streaming example for Node: validate server-sent events + SDK streaming helper. Repro steps: run examples/chat-stream with node 20 and test token limit. Failing when message chunk boundaries split JSON. Potential cause: buffering in example; investigate transform stream.
- [ ] Embed sample app 'chatty-embed' crash on mac M1: stack trace points to native dep (libvips ?) — switch to pure-js resize for CI.
- [ ] Tutorial: "First API Call" is too long; break into 3 micro-steps and add screenshot of response body. Add minimal curl + Node snippet. (Priority: high for onboarding funnel)
- [ ] Docs gap: missing small note about rate-limit headers in hosted API responses — add snippet showing X-RateLimit-Remaining and simple retry-backoff pseudocode.
- [ ] Create lightweight checklist for sample app releases: update README, CI smoke test, bump example version in catalog.

Bugs to triage (quick notes):
- sample logs: GH#67 — failing on GH Actions matrix for py3.11 only. Suspect virtualenv/resolver; ask infra-eng for timeout increase? Marco to confirm.
- streaming JSON corruption: PR#234 fixes buffer flush but doesn't handle partial JSON frames. Possible fix: accumulate until valid JSON parse; add unit test that simulates chunked frames.

Open questions / things to ask in sync:
- Do we want to standardize examples to Node+Python only for GA? (Keeps maintenance small). Pros/cons: user coverage vs. maint burden.
- What SLA for example app uptime in examples repo? Who owns incident on CI flakes?

Notes to self (quick hacks):
- If stuck with binary dep on M1, publish a fallback prebuilt binary path in examples that uses prebuilt x86 via node-ffi? Horrible but unblocks release.
- Keep one minimal reproducible repro for each bug; attach to Linear ticket and close flakey reproductions.

Patch plan (today):
1) 30m: Reproduce streaming JSON corruption locally with small harness that chunks output at random boundaries.
2) 45m: Implement accumulate-until-parse strategy + tests. Push small PR labeled 'devx/wip-stream-fix'.
3) 30m: Short doc edit for "First API Call" — split, add curl + Node, add screenshot placeholder.
4) 30m: Triage GH#67 with Marco; add CI retry or pin dependency.

Useful commands / snippets (to paste into GH PRs or issues):
- Minimal Node streaming consumer:
  const res = await fetch(endpoint, opts);
  for await (const chunk of res.body) { /* accumulate, attempt JSON.parse when ends with newline */ }

- Curl quick test (paste in tutorial):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'

Follow-ups:
- Add checklist to examples README (PR after fixes).
- Quick doc review with Priya tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Random note: create small "streaming-frames.md" micro-spec that defines frame boundaries and recommended parser behavior for all official SDKs. This will reduce cross-language flakiness.

End of scratchpad.
